headache.advice: Over-the-counter pain relievers are usually effective. See a doctor if headaches are frequent or severe.

fever.advice: Rest, stay hydrated, and use antipyretics. Seek medical attention if fever exceeds 103°F (39.4°C) or persists more than 3 days.

allergies.advice: Antihistamines can relieve most allergy symptoms. Consult an allergist for chronic or severe allergies.

pain.advice: Start with OTC pain relievers. If pain is severe or chronic, consult a doctor before using stronger medications.

anxiety.advice: ⚠️ Prescription required. Please consult a psychiatrist or your primary care physician for proper diagnosis and treatment.

depression.advice: ⚠️ Prescription required. Depression requires professional evaluation. Please reach out to a mental health professional.

high blood pressure.advice: ⚠️ Requires medical supervision. Blood pressure medications must be prescribed and monitored by a physician.

diabetes.advice: ⚠️ Requires medical supervision. Diabetes management requires regular monitoring and physician guidance.

inflammation.advice: NSAIDs are effective for mild inflammation. For chronic conditions, consult a doctor about long-term treatment.

infection.advice: ⚠️ Prescription required. Antibiotics must be prescribed by a doctor after proper diagnosis. Never self-medicate with antibiotics.

insomnia.advice: Try sleep hygiene first. OTC melatonin may help. For persistent insomnia, consult a sleep specialist.

nausea.advice: Stay hydrated and eat bland foods. If nausea persists or is accompanied by vomiting, consult a physician.

acid reflux.advice: Proton pump inhibitors and H2 blockers are effective. Avoid trigger foods. See a doctor if symptoms persist beyond 2 weeks.

asthma.advice: ⚠️ Requires medical supervision. Asthma requires a proper treatment plan from a pulmonologist or allergist.

cholesterol.advice: ⚠️ Prescription required. Statins must be prescribed by a physician with regular liver function monitoring.

seizures.advice: ⚠️ CRITICAL: Seizure medications require neurologist supervision. Never stop or change dosage without medical guidance.

blood clots.advice: ⚠️ CRITICAL: Anticoagulants require careful dosing and monitoring. Regular blood tests are essential.

muscle pain.advice: Rest, ice, and OTC pain relievers. If pain persists beyond a week, consult a healthcare provider.

cough.advice: Stay hydrated and rest. OTC cough suppressants can help. See a doctor if cough persists more than 2 weeks.

thyroid.advice: ⚠️ Requires medical supervision. Thyroid medications require regular blood tests and endocrinologist monitoring.

skin rash.advice: Mild rashes can be treated with OTC antihistamines and topical creams. See a dermatologist for persistent or spreading rashes.

stomach pain.advice: Antacids may help. Avoid NSAIDs if you have stomach issues. Consult a doctor for severe or recurring pain.

joint pain.advice: NSAIDs can reduce inflammation and pain. For chronic joint issues, consult a rheumatologist.

constipation.advice: Increase fiber intake and water. OTC laxatives can provide relief. See a doctor if constipation is chronic.

diarrhea.advice: Stay hydrated with electrolyte solutions. OTC anti-diarrheal medications can help. See a doctor if it persists beyond 2 days.
